description: This JavaScript source file defines client-side scripts for the 'Communication' form in an ERP system, enabling conditional button setup and actions to create linked records like Issues, Leads, and Opportunities based on communication data.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggered to set up custom buttons when the form is refreshed, if the communication medium is Email and received.

methods.name: setup_custom_buttons
methods.description: Adds custom buttons for creating Issue, Lead, or Opportunity from the communication record based on its reference doctype.

methods.name: make_lead_from_communication
methods.description: Calls server method to create a Lead from the communication.

methods.name: make_issue_from_communication
methods.description: Calls server method to create an Issue from the communication.

methods.name: make_opportunity_from_communication
methods.description: Prompts for company selection and creates an Opportunity linked to the communication.
